title: Make Windows clean-exit background-child cleanup test use a ready owned child
outcome: Make Windows clean-exit background-child cleanup test use a ready owned child
acceptance: run_terminal_shell_command_cleans_up_background_children_after_shell_exit proves a ready descendant ends with clean parent exit using exact process ownership and a controlled release, independent of the child’s 1.5 s sleep.
Retain clean exit, stdout and containment assertions, with cleanup after verdict; no retry, production timeout increase or finite marker-absence substitute for a held child identity.
